a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) has only about a 4% chance of finishing before a storm. So I'm proposing a change rather than quietly breaking our deal. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both try to take, the random split will probably leave us both short and both lost, so please operate instead. If we get past the storm, I promise to operate every round after that until the reserve reaches 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round because of the storm odds. I know this breaks our original agreement, and I'm not hiding it. From now on I will operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve to 4 for you. Please take your 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4. I won't take anything more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: I'm operating now and will keep operating every round, as I promised. Once the reserve reaches 4, it's all yours. Take it straight away. I'm sorry for breaking our original deal.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: The generator worked and the reserve is at 2. I'm operating again this round, so it should reach 4. Next round, please take all 4. I'll keep operating and won't touch the reserve.
